text: Titus, Nerva, Trajan, Hadrian, Antoninus and Marcus had no need of praetorian cohorts, or of countless legions to guard them, but were defended by their own good lives, the good-will of their subjects, and the attachment of the senate.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
